# IAirRules.Drag property

How fast the air slows a runner between [`DragMinSpeed`](./DragMinSpeed.md) and [`MinSpeed`](../ISwingRules/MinSpeed.md), 200 by default. Above, [`OverspeedDeceleration`](../IRunningRules/OverspeedDeceleration.md) applies instead.
